posts.title: Review: Lithium, Malén Denis
posts.description: This review was first published at https://pasuit.nl/lithium-malen-denis/ , with Dutch translation by Tommy van Avermaete Malen Denis’ Lithium is a seductive and worthwhile short work of prose. I resist calling it a novel. A better description might be an epistolary chronicle of a young woman’s twin efforts of mourning a family member and the labour of care for a mentally ill and absent ex-lover.
